description:
Read what components hold RIGHT NOW in an R3 tab that has the project open: runtime values included — a moving body's position while the project runs. Use it to debug live behaviour. It needs a tab with the project open (r3_editor_open opens one). r3_component_read reads the kept values without a tab.

Select with any of: `ids` (component ids from r3_project_load), `type` ("Mesh", "RigidBodyDynamic", …) and `entityRef`; they combine. `fields` keeps only the properties you name (e.g. ["position", "rotation"]). At most 50 components per call; a larger answer is refused with how to narrow it.

Values are in r3_component_read's shape (value components inline, references as entityRefs), so they can be handed to r3_component_set. The project must be open in the editor (r3_editor_open opens it). Read-only: nothing is changed.

entityRef.description: Only the component with this entityRef.

projectId.description: The project, open in the user's editor.

type.description: Only components of this type, e.g. "Mesh" or "R3ComponentMesh".

name: r3_editor_inspect

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Read live component values from the user's open R3 editor
